title: Invictus Gaming beat Top Esports 3-1 to reach first Worlds semi-final since 2019
summary:
Invictus Gaming knocked out fellow LPL side Top Esports in the opening quarter-final of Worlds 2026 in Allen, Texas. The result guarantees China a semi-final place after the LPL's 0-4 start in the Swiss Stage.

title: KRÜ Blaze win Game Changers Championship from lower bracket, ending Gentle Mates’ unbeaten run
summary:
KRÜ Blaze came through the lower bracket to beat Europe's Gentle Mates GC over five maps in São Paulo, giving LATAM its first Game Changers Championship title. They are also the last winners of the standalone event, as next year's final moves to Champions.

title: TYLOO’s Lisbon forfeit dents Singapore Major hopes as 100 Thieves edge out fnatic
summary:

title: d4v41 and Jinggg leave Paper Rex after 7th–8th Champions finish, Pacific place secure
summary:
